$comment: Golden regression baseline. Scorer is deterministic for a fixed input, so tolerance 0 by default. If you intentionally change the scorer, the baseline (seo-baseline.json / decision-matrix.json) or the sample output, update these values in the same PR and explain why in the PR description.

tolerance.$comment: Per-field absolute tolerance. Keep 0 while input is the static sample; raise (e.g. 2) only when the input becomes a real, slightly non-deterministic agent run.
